functions.name: get_on_road_price
functions.description: Get the complete on-road price for a TVS motorcycle or scooter in a specific city including all taxes and charges

model_name.description: Name of the TVS model (e.g., 'Apache RTR 160', 'Jupiter', 'Ntorq 125', 'iQube')

city.description: City name (Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai, Delhi, or Hyderabad)

functions.name: check_availability
functions.description: Check if a specific TVS model and color combination is available in stock at showrooms in a city

color.description: Preferred color (red, black, blue, white, grey, etc.) - optional

functions.name: find_nearest_showroom
functions.description: Find TVS showrooms in a specific city with address and contact details

functions.name: book_test_drive
functions.description: Book a test drive appointment for a customer to try a TVS vehicle

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number with country code

model_name.description: Model the customer wants to test ride

preferred_time.description: Preferred time - morning, afternoon, or evening (optional)

functions.name: get_model_specs
functions.description: Get detailed specifications of a TVS motorcycle or scooter including engine, mileage, and features

functions.name: navigate_product_section
functions.description: Navigate the customer's screen to show a specific section of a vehicle's details. Use this when discussing pricing, specifications, colors, or features of a TVS vehicle - the customer's browser will automatically switch to the relevant section. If the vehicle isn't already displayed, it will be shown first.

model_name.description: Name of the TVS model (e.g., 'Apache RTR 200 4V', 'Jupiter 125', 'iQube'). Optional if the vehicle is already being shown on screen.

section.description: Which section to display. Use 'pricing' when discussing prices/EMI/on-road costs, 'specifications' for engine/power/mileage details, 'colors' when discussing available colors, 'features' for feature highlights, 'overview' for general product display.

functions.name: escalate_to_human
functions.description: Transfer the conversation to a human agent for complex queries like finance, exchange, complaints, or when customer explicitly requests

model_name.description: Model customer is interested in (if any)
